## Downloads

### Android app
- `app-release.apk` — install directly on your device
- `app-release.aab` — for Google Play upload

### Desktop server
- **Windows** — `.exe` (NSIS) or `.msi` installer
- **Linux** — `.deb` or `.AppImage`
- **macOS** — `.dmg`

### Notes
This release includes both the mobile app and the desktop server.
